title: Dataset curation and captioning for training

questions.q: What does a folder named 5_lamp do in LoadImageTextDataSetFromFolder?
options: Repeats each picture in it 5 times
questions.answer: Repeats each picture in it 5 times
questions.why: The node reads the number before the underscore as a repeat count, in the kohya style.

questions.q: A picture has no .txt file of the same name. What happens?
options: It trains with an empty caption, and no error
questions.answer: It trains with an empty caption, and no error
questions.why: The node appends an empty string when no caption file exists.

questions.q: With 200 pictures, 300 steps and batch 1, how much of the set is never seen, roughly?
questions.why: Each step picks anew. n(1 - 1/n)^steps is 44.5 of 200; the lab's run has 48.

questions.q: A caption is 151 tokens long, on SD 1.5. What does ComfyUI do?
options: It splits it into 3 groups of 77, and joins the results
questions.answer: It splits it into 3 groups of 77, and joins the results
questions.why: The tokenizer starts a new batch at the limit, and encode_token_weights concatenates them. We ran that on the real tokenizer.

questions.q: Every picture is on a beach and your captions never mention it. What does the toy predict about the trigger?
questions.why: What's in every picture and not in the caption has to be carried by the words that are there. In the toy, the beach share of the bare trigger equals the share of pictures on the beach.

questions.q: Which step of this core path shuffles or drops caption words?
options: None: each caption is encoded once before training
questions.answer: None: each caption is encoded once before training
questions.why: MakeTrainingDataset encodes the text once, and the trainer reuses that result.
